newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swissotels to grow with Blackstone Group.
newsitem.headline: Swissotels to grow with Blackstone Group.

text.p: Swissotel, SAirGroup's hotel management company, intends to expand its global presence in cooperation with U.S. merchant bank Blackstone Group.

Swissotel and Blackstone have signed a letter of intent to grow jointly, but this does not exclude the two companies from pursuing projects individually, said a spokesman for SAirRelations, one of SAirGroup's corporate divisions.
"The letter of intent calls for the two companies to grow jontly," the spokesman said.
The idea is that Blackstone will continue its recent path of acquiring hotel properties and Swissotel will manage these.
"This does not exclude that Swissotel also makes smaller investments in properties," the spokesman added.
Earlier Swissotel sold 99 percent of its interest in four U.S. hotel properties in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago and New York to Blackstone Real Estate Partners of of the Blackstone Group.
Blackstone has acquired more than $3.5 billion worth of real-estate in North America and Europe since 1993, including controlling interests in 40 full-service hotels valued in excess of $1.5 billion.
Swissotel's managing director Andreas Meinhold said in March that he wants to manage 60 hotels by year 2000 and this this goal would be reached through a strategic alliance.
